name: Claude Code
description: Claude Code, from Anthropic's signed apt repository (stable channel), set up to start working straight away in a bottle.

permissionMode.description: Permission mode new sessions start in (permissions.defaultMode). The bottle is the sandbox, so the default runs everything without asking.

theme.description: Color theme, so first-run setup doesn't ask.

tui.description: Renderer: default draws inline, fullscreen takes over the terminal.

claude.description: Claude subscription token, from `claude setup-token` (valid for a year)
